children: According to CNBC, South Korean Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il said the semiconductor boom can continue at least through 2027, citing a wide gap between chip demand and supply and ongoing capacity expansion. He said chip stocks have contributed to volatility in South Korea’s stock market. The country expects to collect more taxes than initially projected this year, and Lee said it will ultimately be in a stronger fiscal position because of the chip boom.

title: Lee Hyoung-il: Semiconductor Boom to Last at Least Through 2027
